exposure: Pathogenic compound heterozygous variants in WARS2 gene (c.938A>T and c.298_300delCTT)
outcome: Reduced de novo synthesis of proteins inside mitochondria
Significantly lower steady-state levels of respiratory chain subunits
cohort: A single patient presenting with severe infantile-onset leukoencephalopathy.
finding: The study identified compound heterozygous variants in WARS2 (c.938A>T and c.298_300delCTT) in a patient with severe infantile-onset leukoencephalopathy, profound intellectual disability, spastic quadriplegia, epilepsy, and other symptoms, which correlated with reduced mitochondrial protein synthesis and lower oxygen consumption rates in patient fibroblasts.
